prompt: Who was the oldest Miss Universe titleholder at the time of her crowning, cheered as a triumph over ageism in a youth-obsessed world?
answer: Alejandra Marisa Rodríguez, a 60-year-old Argentine lawyer, was crowned Miss Universe Buenos Aires in 2024. She was celebrated as a symbol against ageism, though she did not win the national Miss Argentina title.
